text:
meera: Quick question — last night's alert for inference-dedicated-oom ended up paging infra oncall instead of the dedicated inference rota. Where is the PagerDuty mapping for dedicated pools kept, and how can I prove the fallback path in logs/traces? cc @sam

sam: PD mapping lives in infra repo under alerting/pagerduty.yml. There are also routing overrides in router-service. If you have an example alert id I can pull the exact rule. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/-/blob/main/alerting/pagerduty.yml

sam: example snippet from pagerduty.yml:
```yaml
- name: dedicated-inference
  service_key: P12345
  escalation_policy: oncall-dedicated
  fallback_policy: infra-oncall
  dedupe_window: 300s
```

jordan: To prove the path, look at the router service logs in Datadog. Query: `source:router service:router status:escalated alert_id:<ALERT_ID>` — you should see a line for the chosen policy + fallback. Traces for the routing decision are in Tempo/Grafana under the `router-decision` dashboard. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/Routing/router-decision

anya: Note we also have a suppression rule that can reroute flapping alerts to infra after 2 repeats in 10m. That lives in router-service config (`/etc/router/config.yaml`) — might be why it went to infra. If the dedicated oncall was marked unavailable, fallback triggers automatically.

ops-lead: If you want the dedicated rota to get the page first, confirm the dedicated PD service key is attached to the correct escalation policy and that the rota has active responders. If it's a one-off, please open a PR to infra/alerting adding a test case, and tag @eng-sre for review.

meera: Thanks. Alert id is `ALRT-2026-03-16-4629`. I'll try the Datadog query and paste logs here. If I don't hear back within 30m I'll open a PR and ping ops.

oncall-bot: Reminder — when editing PD policies, update the `pd-change-log` doc and include the test doc link. See https://confluence.internal/redwood/ops/pagerduty-change-process :bell:

sam: Got it. If you want I can run the routing replay locally against that alert id and show the decision tree. Ping me when you have the logs. :thumbsup:

meera: Will do — dropping the first DD hits here in a sec. Thanks!
